items.source: Obtain a simple PropertyValueConverterFactory capable of instantiating PropertyValueConverter implementations via their default Constructor or in case of an Enum accessing the first enum value.
items.translation: 获取一个简单的 PropertyValueConverterFactory，该工厂能够通过其默认的 Constructor 实例化 PropertyValueConverter 实现；或者在涉及 Enum 时，访问第一个枚举值。

items.source: Obtain a PropertyValueConverterFactory capable of looking up/creating the PropertyValueConverter via the given BeanFactory.
items.translation: 获取一个 PropertyValueConverterFactory，该工厂能够通过给定的 BeanFactory 查找或创建 PropertyValueConverter。

items.source: Obtain a PropertyValueConverterFactory that will cache PropertyValueConverter instances per PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 获取一个 PropertyValueConverterFactory，该工厂将按 PersistentProperty 缓存 PropertyValueConverter 实例。

items.source: Obtain a PropertyValueConverterFactory that will try to obtain a PropertyValueConverter from the given list of factories by returning the first non null one.
items.translation: 获取一个PropertyValueConverterFactory，该工厂将尝试从给定的factories列表中获取一个PropertyValueConverter，方法是返回第一个非 null 的实例。

items.source: Obtain a PropertyValueConverterFactory that will try to obtain a PropertyValueConverter from the given array of factories by returning the first non null one.
items.translation: 获取一个PropertyValueConverterFactory，该工厂将从给定的factories数组中尝试获取一个PropertyValueConverter，方法是返回第一个非 null 的实例。

items.source: Obtain a PropertyValueConverterFactory capable of looking up the PropertyValueConverter in the given PropertyValueConverterRegistrar.
items.translation: 获取一个能够根据给定的 PropertyValueConverterRegistrar 查找 PropertyValueConverter 的 PropertyValueConverterFactory。

items.source: Get the PropertyValueConverter applicable for the given PersistentProperty.
items.translation: 获取适用于给定PersistentProperty的PropertyValueConverter。

items.source: Get the converter by its type.
items.translation: 根据类型获取转换器。

items.source: Depending on the applications' need factories can be chained and the resulting converter may be cached.
items.translation: 根据应用程序的需求，factories 可以chained（链接），生成的 converter 可能还会被cached（缓存）。
